newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 282 OF NOVEMBER 1, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 282 OF NOVEMBER 1, 1996.
